items.note: System paper (Polymind, multi-agent LLM diagramming for prewriting) with a user evaluation against ChatGPT; abstract reports customizability and faster idea expansion but no scored creativity outcome or sample size, so it may turn out to be system_paper or self-report only; arXiv 2502.09577 is the same work.

Five preregistered randomized field experiments (528 individuals in 176 teams) on generative AI in team NPD ideation; AI raised idea diversity, variety and depth but not fluency or usefulness; 528 is the total across five experiments, so the largest single experiment may be smaller; conference abstract only, look for a full paper.

Twenty designers ideated with GAN-generated versus ordinary combinational image stimuli; outcome appears to rest on participants' subjective self-evaluation, so it may be self_report_only, and GAN stimuli may fall outside the generative-AI scope; below 50 participants.

Two simulation-based experiments and a field experiment varying AI-first versus human-first idea generation sequence, with trust in AI as moderator; outcomes are idea diversity and creativity; this is an AI-configuration comparison; conference abstract only, sample sizes not stated.

Comparative experiment of a human-AI co-creative design process versus a traditional design process across novice and experienced designers; creative performance higher with AI; assignment and sample size not stated in the abstract (may be within-person).

Twenty practitioners made anime-style clips with generative AI under a baseline or a structured Kano-AHP workflow (AI-configuration comparison, 10 per arm); experts and 60 viewers rated quality; randomization stated only for the viewer design, not for practitioners; below 50 participants.

Randomized field experiment delivering LLM feedback on 31,000+ arXiv preprints (45,000+ researchers); outcomes are revision probability and later LLM use, with no creativity, novelty, or diversity outcome.

System paper (AIdeation) with a user study of 16 professional concept designers comparing it with their current tools, reporting higher creativity, efficiency and satisfaction (creativity may be self-reported), plus a one-week field study; below 50 participants; arXiv 2502.14747 is the same work.

Crossover experiment (8 designers, 16 users) comparing the Multi-PDAI multimodal GenAI participatory-design platform with Stable Diffusion; 10 experts rated generated images as more innovative and aesthetic (AI-configuration comparison); below 50 participants.

Crowdsourced mixed-methods experiment on smart replies and loss of human agency; outcomes concern message content and behavior, not creativity or diversity, and the abstract does not say the smart replies come from a generative model; arXiv 2210.06470 is the same work.
